principle: No task is forgotten: every request, integration, target or debt item is tracked here until evidence-backed closure or an explicit owner decision.

status_definitions.ci_verified: Automated tests/CI passed for the specific source commit; not a live integration or production proof.
status_definitions.implemented_pending_ci: Code and contract tests have been added on this branch; CI has not validated this change yet.
status_definitions.implemented_unverified: Code exists, but live service/provider/device behavior has not been verified.
status_definitions.open_pr: Implementation exists on a pull request that is still open/unmerged.
status_definitions.candidate_not_enabled: Candidate identified but access, entitlement, terms or actual inference has not passed a live qualification probe.
status_definitions.blocked_owner: Requires owner account access, credential setup, device authorization, billing decision or external approval.
status_definitions.needs_owner_review: Requires owner review of destination, safety, scope or a prior incident.
status_definitions.planned: Explicitly identified work that has not been implemented.
status_definitions.target_unmeasured: Strategic capacity goal; no measured validation exists.
status_definitions.pending_ci: Waiting for CI on this exact branch/commit.

tasks.title: SQLite queue, atomic claims, retries and stale-lease recovery
tasks.current_state: Core queue tests pass in CI run #244 on the PR candidate branch.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Restart recovery, unique claims, stale lease and bounded retries remain green on the release SHA.

tasks.title: Bounded role-based producer/reviewer/finalizer orchestration
tasks.evidence: Routine and CVPen swarm contract tests are present.
tasks.current_state: Regression suite confirms stage order, independent review fan-out and finalizer inputs.

tasks.title: Expand specialist registry to 44 roles and 21 teams
tasks.current_state: 44 role IDs and 21 teams now exist on this branch; CI has not yet run for this commit.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Validate unique IDs, all team references and team coverage in CI.

tasks.title: Persist project-scoped memory for each agent identity
tasks.current_state: SQLite per-agent memory and scoped retrieval code added; CI pending.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Memory survives process restart, is isolated by agent/project and applies expiry.

tasks.title: Persist job + agent + stage checkpoint and resume completed stages
tasks.current_state: Worker now reuses completed non-sensitive stage output; sensitive task outputs are not checkpointed.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Injected restart between stages proves completed safe stages are not re-run and sensitive data is not duplicated.

tasks.title: Store external agent provider/task IDs, status, last event and result references
tasks.current_state: External task table and methods added; no external run dispatch scheduler is connected yet.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: A remote task can be looked up and continued after Qudron restart.

tasks.title: Expose execution continuity and per-agent memory through owner-authenticated MCP tools
tasks.current_state: Read-only MCP tools added; CI pending.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Authorized MCP caller can query continuity and one role's scoped memory; invalid input is rejected.

tasks.title: Maintain short-term project and long-term portfolio memory
tasks.current_state: Existing shared project memory uses SQLite and redaction before persistence.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Memory scoping, TTL and redaction regressions stay green.

tasks.title: Make every new ChatGPT session recover the latest project state and next action
tasks.current_state: Repository state manifest and session-resume protocol are being added; automatic session access is not guaranteed by ChatGPT itself.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: New conversation reads the authoritative repo/PR state and identifies the last completed commit, tasks and next step.

tasks.title: Automatically publish runtime checkpoints and task changes back to GitHub
tasks.current_state: Runtime GitHub write token and approved sync permission are not configured.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: A least-privilege, audited sync writes sanitized state snapshots with idempotency and no secrets.

tasks.title: Model 10,000 logical specialist workers with persistent identity and memory
tasks.current_state: Logical capacity remains a target; no 10,000-agent load test or scheduler evidence exists.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Load test confirms durable admission, per-agent memory and queue fairness at an agreed scale.

tasks.title: Run 10,000 simultaneous model inference workers
tasks.current_state: Not a current promise or a safe default; upstream quotas, inference concurrency and host resources are unmeasured.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Only claim a tested simultaneous count after load test and provider approvals.

tasks.title: Schedule and supervise large external agent batches across approved providers
tasks.current_state: External task ledger exists; dispatch, fair quota scheduler, poll workers and admission control remain to be built.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: A bounded batch is dispatched, resumed, retried, cancelled and reconciled with exact per-provider counts.

tasks.title: Run browser-based external agents with durable task state and artifacts

completion_policy: Do not convert a task to ci_verified or closed merely because code, documentation, a model name, a page or an adapter exists. Require evidence matching its acceptance criteria.
